description: gitlab CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record): the stack this plugin's own tests run in. Installs the depends_on closure (identity_core, aws_core; neither declares dependencies of its own) and gitlab itself; the consumer flips self to editable so the checkout under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population seeds gitlab's page bundle, which proves it imports. Deliberately excluded: every other plugin, all credentials, anything that reaches the network.

plugins.note: Vocabulary dependency: owns identity_core__oidc_issuer and TRUSTS_ISSUER, which an OIDC sign-in provider points at. Rides main until it has a tagged release (starter record pinned by rev only).

Vocabulary dependency: owns ROUTES_TRAFFIC, which the /gitlab page's ingress search names, and the AWS types the page draws. Rides main until it has a tagged release (starter record pinned by rev only).

Self, pinned at the bootstrap commit until the first tagged release; the consumer (plugin-ci, or `spawn --dev-plugins gitlab`) substitutes the checkout under test via tap.dev_workspace (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-4).

steps.note: gitlab's own bundle: the /gitlab page, its panels, searches and projection.
